calculation_handling.description: If fewer than 13 effective parking spaces, at least 1 accessible parking space.
calculation_handling.gaps: No accessible-parking target exists in the vocabulary and the effective parking count is not held.

units.disclosure: Where fewer than 13 effective parking spaces result from the table, at least 1 accessible space is required. Not evaluated.

literals_not_expressed.literal: 1 parking space for every 25 effective parking spaces

calculation_handling.description: If 13 to 100 effective parking spaces, at least 1 accessible space for every 25 effective spaces or part thereof.
calculation_handling.gaps: No accessible-parking target exists in the vocabulary and the effective parking count is not held.

units.disclosure: Where 13 to 100 effective parking spaces result, 1 accessible space is required for every 25 or part thereof. Not evaluated.

literals_not_expressed.literal: 1 parking space for every 50 effective parking spaces

calculation_handling.description: If more than 100 effective parking spaces, at least 5 accessible spaces plus 1 for every 50 effective spaces or part thereof above 100.
calculation_handling.gaps: No accessible-parking target exists in the vocabulary and the effective parking count is not held.

units.disclosure: Where more than 100 effective parking spaces result, 5 accessible spaces plus 1 for every 50 above 100 are required. Not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For medical offices and clinics, accessible parking is at least 10 percent of the effective parking spaces, rounded up.
calculation_handling.gaps: Non-residential use; no accessible-parking target exists.

units.disclosure: Medical offices and clinics must provide accessible parking equal to at least 10 percent of effective parking spaces, rounded up. Not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Lawfully existing accessible parking spaces for a medical office or clinic must be retained.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built parking facts; not held.

units.disclosure: Accessible parking spaces that lawfully exist on the lot must be kept. Not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The parking requirement for vacant building space is based on the previous use of that space.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the previous use of the building; not held.

calculation_handling.description: The parking requirement for vacant building space is based on the land use on the issued building permit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the permit history; not held.

calculation_handling.description: For space never used and with no permit use, the parking requirement is based on the permitted zone use with the lowest minimum parking requirement.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the permit history and the zone's permitted use list; not held.

calculation_handling.description: Where a parking rate is per gross floor area, the requirement is the use's gross floor area multiplied by the rate in Table 970.10.15.5.
calculation_handling.gaps: The table rate and per-use gross floor area are not held in the vocabulary.

calculation_handling.description: Areas for required parking spaces (other than stacked and tandem spaces) need direct, unobstructed driveway access to a street or lane, not counting a gate or movable barrier.
calculation_handling.gaps: Driveway layout and obstructions are not held.

units.disclosure: Required parking spaces, other than stacked or tandem ones, must have direct, unobstructed driveway access to a street or lane. Not evaluated.

970.10.15.5(17).explanation: When dwelling units have 5 or more parking spaces (or other uses have 1 or more), accessible spaces are required based on effective parking spaces: 1 if fewer than 13, 1 per 25 (or part) for 13 to 100, and 5 plus 1 per 50 (or part) above 100.

970.10.15.5(18).explanation: A medical office or clinic with any parking must provide accessible spaces equal to 10 percent of its effective parking spaces, rounded up, and keep any lawfully existing accessible spaces.

970.10.15.5(2).explanation: The parking requirement for vacant building space follows its previous use, then the use on the building permit, and if neither exists, the permitted use in the zone with the lowest minimum parking requirement.

970.10.15.5(3).explanation: A parking rate expressed per gross floor area is applied by multiplying the use's gross floor area by the rate in Table 970.10.15.5.

970.10.15.5(4).explanation: Required parking spaces, except stacked and tandem spaces, must have direct, unobstructed driveway access to a street or lane; a gate or movable barrier does not count as an obstruction.
